changelog: - **A selected node's paths stay visible when zoomed out, and zone edges are clearer.** The connections that touch a selected node are drawn at least 2 px wide on screen at every zoom, so its paths can be followed at the overview; other connections are unchanged, and Focus mode still dims the rest. The five zone colours are stronger, in light and dark, and a coloured zone's edge is drawn at full strength while its fill stays as faint as before; the zone name's border and the colour choices in the zone's properties take the same new colours.
